scientific integrity: The proof reduces the global product optimization to five dihedral support classes and supplies exact positive-semidefinite certificates in Q(sqrt(2)); the bundled checker recomputes all 75 principal minors and the equality witness without floating-point decisions. The literature comparison includes the defining 2021 article, the 2024 same-object Euler--Lagrange paper, and the complete 2025 skew generalized Zbaganu paper.
scientific limitations: The result concerns the displayed regular-octagonal norm and only the parameter pair (2,3). It does not give the full two-parameter profile or a uniqueness classification of maximizers.
title: Exact \(C_Z(2,3)\) for the regular octagonal Banach plane
